utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — ten o’clock at the community shed still works, and I’m glad you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, ten at the community shed—I’ll bring my toolbox and some spare screws if I can find them. Thanks for keeping me pointed the right way, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds helpful, Oren. Just come by at ten, and we’ll put those screws to good use if you find them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s happening this Saturday, 10 to 2 at the Maple Street garden shed. If Rosa can help, ask her to bring any small hand tools or spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Leo, that’s out of date—it’s confirmed for Sunday at the community center now. I can bring some small hand tools and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good catch—Sunday at the community center, got it. Please bring the hand tools and spare screws, and I’ll keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds like it’s still moving—let’s just make sure Maple Street’s fully covered first, then we can slot the bikes and that fence.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—if Maple Street still needs a shift, I’m free between 8:30 and 2:30, just not during school drop-off or pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—that window helps a lot; I’ll pencil you in for Maple once we confirm the last houses.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can bring my toolbox and the spare drill, and I’ll text over what’s in it tonight so we don’t end up doubling up at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Gus—send me that list tonight and I’ll fold it into the supply sheet so we can see what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll send it over tonight, and if the sheet still shows any gaps after that, I’m happy to help fill in what I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street shed works for me, so once Quinn confirms it, I’ll put together a simple repair list and fit Faye in around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Eli—once Quinn confirms, send me the list and I’ll keep us lined up around Faye’s windows and whatever Dane wants fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That suits me, Mara—once Quinn confirms Saturday 10 to 2 at the Maple Street shed, I’ll send over the simple repair list so we can place Faye neatly around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve been hearing, it’s still the plan for this weekend, but folks are gathering tools and hands as if it’s nearly set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds close, but I’d rather not spread it until the timing is firm—Rosa confirmed Sunday at the community center, and I’m still waiting on Gus’s tool list so we don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That makes sense—I’ll keep it to Sunday at the community center for now, and if Gus’s tool list comes through I’ll pass that along so folks don’t bring duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed. If you can pass that along, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll spread that it’s Saturday 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed, and I’ll make sure I’ve got the location marked correctly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Opal—I really appreciate you helping get the word out, and I’d love to see you there too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, last I heard they still needed basic tools, tarps, maybe work gloves, and a couple more volunteers, but I might be behind—Cleo’s probably got the clean list if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—I want to verify the current sign-up count and check with Leo whether tools and pickup times are still open before I say what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that makes sense—Cleo’s probably the best one to confirm the current list, since I’m a little behind if anything shifted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve only heard bits so far, Sam, but if it’s mostly small fixes and there’s a clear list, I could probably help with a few simple jobs—what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds perfect—Quinn said it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed, and I’m in to help however I can. If we can get a clear list together, I’ll pitch in on whatever small fixes need doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense—if there’s a clear list for Saturday, I can probably take on a simple fix or ask around a bit too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still asking around and pulling people together for the repair drive, and I’ll pass along the day and time tonight as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik—I’m still running a bit late on locking it down, but let folks know we’re starting with the bikes and that loose garden fence once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know we’re starting with the bikes and that loose garden fence once you’ve got the time locked down tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I’m still out on errands, so I really appreciate you spreading the word and keeping me posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course, Ira—I’ll reach out to a few folks from different circles and keep it simple until Gus sends that tool list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—I really appreciate that while I’m still out on errands. Keep me posted once Gus sends the tool list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on a solid answer from Mara, so I can’t confirm the porch steps, shed patching, or the materials yet. I did hear Faye’s free from 8:30 to 2:30 if that helps once we know what’s open.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then check with Mara now, please—besides Jonah on the fence and Bea on tools, do we have anyone definite for the porch steps or shed patching yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not that I can confirm yet—I’ve only heard Jonah’s on the fence and Bea’s covering tools, and I’m still waiting on Mara to pin down the porch steps, shed patching, and whether the materials are already lined up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help pull folks in from a few different circles for the repair drive—if Cleo’s got the latest needs list, I can start spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before you spread the word, can you confirm you’ve got the same final details Rosa gave us—that it’s definitely this weekend in the community room at Maple Court by the front entrance?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t want to overstate it—I’ve heard the needs side through Cleo, but I haven’t personally confirmed Rosa’s final location-and-time details yet. If Rosa already gave you that it’s this weekend in the community room at Maple Court by the front entrance, I’ll treat that as the working plan while I double-check before spreading it wider.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If it’s mostly those small fixes and they’ve got a clear sign-up list, I could help with a simple job or ask around a bit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Rey—I’m just waiting on Gus’s tool list so I don’t send people into a muddle, but it’s Sunday at the community center now. Once I’ve got the timing and what’s still needed pinned down, I’ll let you know where a simple job would fit best.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, that sounds good—once you’ve got the list settled, tell me what still needs doing and I’ll see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for Saturday at the Maple Street shed from ten to two—tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—skim me the sign-up count first, then I’ll match houses and see what’s still open; I mostly need to know whether Leo’s locked the tools and pickup times yet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the sign-up count and whether Leo’s set the tool lockup and pickup times, then I’ll send you the rundown so you can match the houses.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, they still need the porch steps, the alley fence, and some patching at the shed—Jonah’s on the fence and Bea was sorting tools, but I’d still want Mara or Rosa to confirm the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps—I'll keep the supply list centered on tarps, work gloves, tape, extension cords, and cleaning rags until Mara or Rosa confirm what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that sounds smart—I’ve only got second-hand bits, so I’d treat that as a placeholder until Mara or Rosa confirms who’s covering the steps and shed patching.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, the repair drive’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed—can you come by, and maybe help spread the word to a neighbor or two?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the community shed at ten; I can come by and help, and I’ll mention it to a couple neighbors if I don’t forget.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Oren—thanks; Saturday from 10 to 2 at the Maple Street community garden shed, and the more neighbors who hear about it, the better.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Faye, I’ve got the repair drive marked at the community room at Maple Court, right by the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Opal—I can take a shift there anytime between 8:30 and 2:30, just not during school drop-off or pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps a lot, Faye—I’ve got you down as available at the Maple Court community room between 8:30 and 2:30, outside school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Noah—let’s start on the bikes first, then head over to the loose fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, bikes first sounds right—I think Cleo’s still got the best read on supplies, and then we can swing by that fence by the garden.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good call—if Cleo’s got supplies covered, I’ll jump in on the bikes now and we can head to the garden fence right after.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik—I really appreciate you spreading the word. It’s still looking like Saturday at ten by the Maple Street garden shed, and I’ll confirm the moment that last piece comes through.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—Saturday at ten by the Maple Street garden shed unless that last confirmation shifts it, and I’ll keep repeating that to folks until you update me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. That takes a load off—I’ll send you the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll still send that list tonight, and Saturday I can bring my toolbox and spare drill so Maple Street’s covered without doubling up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — I’m still out on errands, but that helps a lot, so please keep me posted tonight once the list’s together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do—I’ll text you the list tonight, and unless anything changes I’ll plan on bringing the toolbox and spare drill Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m confirming the weekend timing today and I’ll send you the tool list and start times right after, so you can slot Faye in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo—send me the times as soon as you have them, and I’ll fit Faye around her school runs so we can start on the busted bikes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do—I’ll confirm the weekend timing today and send you the tool list and start times right after.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday 10 to 2 at the Maple Street shed still looks right to me, and I’m making the repair list first so we can fit Faye in around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That matches what I’ve been hearing, Eli—still sounds like Saturday at the Maple Street shed, just waiting on that last bit of confirmation before everyone treats it as locked in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that’s the sensible order—I'll finish the repair list and check what we already have at the shed, then we can confirm the gaps and place Faye cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mina, the repair drive is confirmed for Sunday at the community center now, and it’ll be right by the front entrance so folks can find it easily.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—how many houses are signed up so far, and what exactly still needs fixing with confirmed names on the porch steps and shed patching?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m still tallying the exact house count, Mina, but the confirmed fixes I have on the list are porch-step repairs and shed patching for the homes already signed up. I’ll give you the names as soon as I finish the roster check.
